official_questions.stem:
Consider the following statements, with reference to e-RUPI :
I. It is a seamless one-time payment mechanism.
II. It is powered by NPCI (National Payments Corporation of India).
III. It was developed with the support of DFS (Department of Financial Services) and NHA (National Health Authority).
IV. It was launched in the year 2020.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
official_questions.core_fact: e-RUPI, launched by PM Modi on 2 Aug 2021, is a cashless, contactless, person- and purpose-specific one-time payment voucher (QR/SMS) developed by NPCI on UPI with DFS, MoHFW and the National Health Authority.

statements.t: e-RUPI is a seamless one-time payment mechanism.
e-RUPI is powered by NPCI.
e-RUPI was developed with the support of DFS and NHA.

official_questions.rule: e-RUPI = 2021 voucher (NPCI) vs e-rupee CBDC = 2022 (RBI) - do not mix.

official_questions.stem:
Recently, NITI Aayog approved a proposal to conduct a study on the use of facial recognition technology in India. In the context of facial recognition technology, consider the following statements :
I. A National Automated Facial Recognition System (NAFRS) is being developed by the National Informatics Centre, under the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology.
II. The biggest demerit of facial recognition technology is its limitation in identifying people in real-time and not in photos and videos.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
official_questions.core_fact: NAFRS is being developed by NCRB under MHA; FRT works on live feeds as well as photos/videos – main concerns are privacy, accuracy, bias.

statements.t: NAFRS is being developed by NIC under MeitY.
statements.fact: NAFRS is being developed by NCRB under the Ministry of Home Affairs.

statements.t: The biggest demerit of FRT is its limitation in identifying people in real time, not in photos and videos.
statements.d: limitation in identifying people in real-time
statements.fact: FRT can identify in real time and in photos/videos; its main demerits are privacy, accuracy and bias.

official_questions.rule: NAFRS = NCRB/MHA; DigiYatra uses FRT at airports.

official_questions.stem:
With reference to RFID Technology, consider the following statements :
I. Passive RFID tags are powered by an internal circuit and utilize it to send response to the reader.
II. Semi-passive RFID tags comprise an internal circuit with power source but rely on radio waves received from the reader to transmit the response.
III. Active RFID tags acquire their power from the readers’ incoming radio waves.
IV. RFID Technology can scan a tag as long as it is within frequency range and it does not have any line-of-sight limitations.
Which of the statements given above are correct ?
official_questions.core_fact: Passive tags have no battery and are powered by reader waves; semi-passive have a battery for circuits but use reader waves to reply; active tags have own battery; RFID needs no line of sight.

statements.t: Passive RFID tags are powered by an internal circuit and use it to send the response to the reader.
statements.fact: Passive tags draw power from reader's radio waves.

statements.t: Semi-passive tags have internal power but rely on reader waves to transmit.
Active RFID tags acquire their power from the readers' incoming radio waves.
statements.d: acquire their power from the readers
statements.fact: Active tags have their own battery.

statements.t: RFID can scan a tag within range without line-of-sight limitations.

official_questions.rule: Passive no battery; active battery; no LOS (unlike barcode).

official_questions.stem:
With reference to “Blockchain Technology”, consider the following statements :
I. It is a public ledger that everyone can inspect, but no single user controls.
II. The structure and design of blockchain is such that all the data in it are about cryptocurrency only.
III. Applications that depend on basic features of blockchain can be developed without anybody’s permission.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct ?
official_questions.core_fact: A public blockchain is a distributed ledger anyone can inspect but no single user controls; it records any data (land records, supply chains, certificates), not only cryptocurrency; open (permissionless) chains allow applications without anyone's permission.

statements.t: Blockchain is a public ledger everyone can inspect but no single user controls.
All data in a blockchain are about cryptocurrency only.
statements.fact: Blockchains can store any data – land records, supply chains, certificates – not only cryptocurrency.

statements.t: Applications based on blockchain can be developed without anybody's permission.

official_questions.rule: Blockchain ≠ Bitcoin; permissioned vs permissionless chains.

official_questions.stem:
Consider the following Assertion (A) and Reason (R) and choose the correct code :
Assertion (A) : 'India Stack' has enabled an online, paperless and cashless digital access to various public and private services. This has reduced the cost of conducting e-KYC.
Reason (R) : India Stack consists of two interconnected layers, and of these, the 'Payment Layer' has reduced the cost of conducting e-KYC.
options: Both (A) and (R) are true and (R) explains (A).
Both (A) and (R) are true, but (R) does not explain (A).
official_questions.core_fact: India Stack = identity (Aadhaar, e-KYC), payments (UPI) and data (DigiLocker, Account Aggregator) layers.

statements.t: India Stack has enabled online, paperless and cashless digital access to public and private services, reducing the cost of e-KYC.
statements.d: reduced the cost of conducting e-KYC

statements.t: India Stack consists of two interconnected layers, and the Payment Layer has reduced the cost of e-KYC.
statements.fact: India Stack has three layers (identity, payments, data); cheaper e-KYC comes from the identity (Aadhaar) layer.

statements.t: The payment layer explains the lower e-KYC cost.
statements.fact: The identity layer, not the payment layer, lowered e-KYC cost.

official_questions.rule: India Stack: 3 layers - identity (e-KYC), payments (UPI), data (consent).

official_questions.stem:
Consider the following statements about Garbhini-GA2 :
I. It is the first India-specific Artificial Intelligence (AI) model which accurately determines the age of a fetus in pregnant women in the second and third trimesters.
II. Garbhini-GA2 was developed by the researchers at the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras and Translational Health Science and Technology Institute (THSTI), Faridabad.
Which among the above statements is/are correct ?
official_questions.core_fact: Garbhini-GA2 (Feb 2024) is the first India-specific AI model to estimate fetal (gestational) age in the 2nd and 3rd trimesters, developed by IIT Madras and THSTI Faridabad under DBT's GARBH-Ini programme.

statements.t: Garbhini-GA2 is the first India-specific Artificial Intelligence (AI) model which accurately determines the age of a fetus in pregnant women in the second and third trimesters.

official_questions.rule: Garbhini-GA2 = fetal age (2nd/3rd trimester), IIT-M + THSTI; watch swaps to AIIMS/ICMR or to 'first trimester'.
